title: Al Hibbler stories: George Shearing, Billy Eckstine and the light bulbs
summary: Funny stories about blind singer Al Hibbler, including a prank on George Shearing and Hibbler's trick on his wife.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: January 6th, and I'm forcing you to let me turn on the tape recorder because you're about to tell me a story.

Yes. Well, I just finished telling one, but I'll tell it again. The story of George Shearing, when he was working at Birdland, and somebody was playing a joke on him, and you must realize he's blind and that he came upstairs and got in the back seat of the car, but he didn't realize Al Hibbler, who is blind too, was the driver. And Al had learned where the starter was, and George was saying, "Where are we going," and somebody happened to reach in the window and tell him, "You know, that's Al Hibbler driving," and you've never seen a blind man run that fast.

And Al laughs about it now, you know. And there was another time when we were doing a tour. They used to call them Birdland tours. And they had a -- Count Basie, I was working with Sarah Vaughan at that time, and Billy Eckstine. Billy's got a heart as big as an oak tree, but he's got some funny humor, you know? He used to take Al walking and walk him into a wall.
And Al would call him all kinds of dirty names. He'd say, "I can't see you, but I know what you are."

And there was another story about Al with his wife. She was running around with some fellow, you know, so what Al did, he fooled around and took all the bulbs out of the ceiling in the hotel where they were staying. Got up on the table and took all of the ceiling bulbs out, and everything. So when she came in all she could hear was his voice. He said, "Now we're both even. You can't see and I can't see, and I'm going to give you the damndest whipping you ever had."
But the bottom line was that she kept saying, "Stop, Al." He said, "If you were smart you'd shut up and I wouldn't know where you are."
"You keep talking. That's the way I find you. I just hear your voice, you know?" So -- oh, there's a whole lot of comedic things that I can remember and associate with.
